paragraphs: Casebook PBC sells human services software that covers the work from intake through reporting. It is configurable software built to fit an organization's programs, workflows and reporting requirements.

Teams can standardize intake and assessments. Client data is stored in one system. Reporting starts from templates for common reports, and custom reports can be built for exact needs. Pricing is per user, with flexible plans that let an organization pick the number of users that makes sense for it.

The company describes itself as a public benefit corporation led by a set of core beliefs. It says its SaaS product serves government agencies and nonprofits of all sizes, from intake to case management. Its case studies page says agencies, nonprofits and police departments use Casebook to cut hours of paperwork and turn case notes into proof for funders and boards. The about page notes inclusion in the GovTech 100 list for 2024.

quote.text: By centralizing tracking, communication, and faster reporting, Casebook PBC reduces operational costs, fosters internal collaboration, and helps the helpers accelerate an end to poverty.
